package.name: helios_description
package.description: URDF/xacro description for the Lynxmotion A4WD3 mecanum "Helios" rover. Rough primitives model (chassis box + 4 wheels) with TODO sensor mount frames for the ZED 2i camera and Hokuyo UST-10LX LiDAR. Provides the base_link TF tree for sensor fusion and visualization.
